mapper.insert: insert into tbl_file (original_name, file_name, file_path, file_size) values (#{originalName}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize})
mapper.select: select f.id, f.original_name, f.file_name, f.file_path, f.file_size, f.created_datetime from tbl_file_member fm join tbl_file f on f.id = fm.id where fm.member_id = #{memberId} order by f.id desc limit 1
